name: raememberit
description: Memory discipline for Claude Code: a two-tier context budget, indexes generated from frontmatter, and hooks that make capture involuntary.

user.title: How to address you
user.description: How the assistant should address you in its own memory files. Left empty, memories read impersonally.

memoryDir.title: Corpus location
memoryDir.description: Corpus location. Keep it inside the config directory so the whole directory stays one portable unit.

dupes.title: Duplicate gate
dupes.description: Duplicate gate on write. 'block' refuses a near-duplicate, 'warn' writes it and says so, 'off' skips the check. Start on 'warn' when adopting an existing corpus.

requireLog.title: Require an interaction log
requireLog.description: Whether a session may end without an interaction log. 'strict' refuses, 'warn' reminds, 'off' says nothing.

precompactMessage.title: Pre-compaction reminder
precompactMessage.description: What the pre-compaction reminder says. Empty uses the default wording.

recentN.title: Recent logs in the index
recentN.description: How many recent interaction logs the always-on index lists. The always-on tier has no natural ceiling, so this is the knob that bounds it.

personaFile.title: Persona file
personaFile.description: Optional path to a persona file appended to the instruction fragment.

vocabularyFile.title: Vocabulary file
vocabularyFile.description: Optional path to a project-vocabulary file used when expanding recall queries.
